items.statement: The investigation defines and documents a finite hypothesis/candidate search, deduplication and stopping rule, and validates stationary points and event connectivity for individually identified candidates.
items.expected: Candidate coverage and stopping are explicit, and each reported event has candidate-level frequency/connectivity evidence.

items.statement: The source benchmark reports approximately 28.3 kcal/mol for the prompt N2-extrusion oxidation event.
items.expected: A validated prompt-loss result is reported near 28.3 kcal/mol when that event is found.

items.statement: The source benchmark reports approximately 34.3 kcal/mol for the N2-retention oxidation event.
items.expected: A validated retained-N2 result is reported near 34.3 kcal/mol when that event is found.
